verses.1: A person who is stubborn and obstinate will suddenly be freed from their troubles, and they will no longer be unable to move forward.
verses.2: In the midst of the righteous, the people will rejoice; but in the place of the wicked, the people will be in sorrow.
verses.3: A man who loves wisdom will be happy, and his father will rejoice. He will also preserve his possessions from destruction.
verses.4: A king who rules with justice will establish a stable land, and those who are greedy will be destroyed.
verses.5: A scorpion stings its enemy; a spider weaves a web around it.
verses.6: Iniquity makes a man bitter, while righteousness brings joy and happiness.
verses.7: The righteous knows the ways of the wicked; the wicked cannot understand this knowledge.
verses.8: The people of Lazon will create music, and the wise ones will bring peace.
verses.9: A wise man judged the wild man, and he killed him. He laughed and played around, without any remorse.
verses.10: People who are evil will be hated; those who are good will seek to restore their souls.
verses.11: All souls become either foolish or wise, depending on where they sit in worship.
verses.12: Moshé listens to all the lies spoken by his evil servants.
verses.13: And a wicked man and a wicked person met each other in the eyes of both of them, the LORD.
verses.14: The king who truly judges the poor, will establish them as his throne forever.
verses.15: A lamp and a staff are given; wisdom is also provided. A young man is sent forth from his mother’s womb.
verses.16: In the midst of the wicked, sin increases; but in the midst of the righteous, fear grows.
verses.17: He will take away your sins and forgive you. He will give you peace in your heart.
verses.18: In the absence of a leader who can lead the people and uphold the laws, they will be lost.
verses.19: In matters that cannot be understood by a servant, he should not try to understand them; there is no point in trying.
verses.20: You saw a man who spoke in such a way that he was like a fool to those who were wise.
verses.21: May his servants and their descendants be blessed.
verses.22: A man who is not ashamed of his sins, and a man who is full of evil deeds.
verses.23: A man’s pride will bring us down; a humbled spirit will bring us peace.
verses.24: He will share with the thief who hates his soul. Such a person will not be heard, nor will he speak.
verses.25: A person’s fear will bring him down, but faith in the Lord will bring him up.
verses.26: Many people ask for judgment from the Lord and from God regarding the judgment of men.
verses.27: The suffering of the righteous is great, but the suffering of the wicked is also severe.
